# Diksha Home Stay Bhandardara

> Diksha Home Stay is a newly constructed, premium, couple-friendly stay in Bhandardara, Maharashtra. It features 5 private rooms and a spacious 2BHK unit with attached bathrooms, free parking, and a Government Hospital just 50 feet away for complete safety.
